empty: No address may reach this account from outside the server.
addFailed: The address could not be allowed.
removeFailed: The address could not be removed.
serverOff: Remote database access is switched off for this server. Ask your provider to turn it on.
security: Only the addresses listed here can reach the database from outside. Everything else is refused before it arrives.

field.label: Note
field.hint: A single IP address or a range. An IPv6 range cannot be used because the database server cannot match one; enter a single IPv6 address instead.

switch.label: Remote database access
switch.onHint: The database is listening on port {{port}}; only allowed addresses get through.
switch.offHint: The database listens on this server only.
switch.confirmOn: The database server restarts, which drops every open connection. Sites reconnect on their own, but anything mid-query fails. Continue?
switch.confirmOff: The database server restarts and stops listening for outside connections. Every remote client loses access. Continue?
switch.failed: The setting could not be applied.
switch.portRuleConflict: A firewall rule already targets port {{port}}. Remove it first, or it will silently block everything allowed here.

reasons.db_remote_server_disabled: Remote database access is switched off for this server.
reasons.db_remote_host_invalid: Enter an IP address or a CIDR range.
reasons.db_remote_ipv6_range_unsupported: The database server cannot match an IPv6 range. Enter a single IPv6 address.
reasons.db_remote_host_too_broad: That range is too broad. Allow a narrower one, or use a VPN with a fixed address.
reasons.db_remote_port_rule_conflict: A firewall rule already targets the database port. Remove it first.
reasons.db_remote_unknown_user: That database user does not belong to this site.
reasons.db_remote_apply_failed: The database server did not accept the change, so nothing was altered.
